title: Korean War — US Leads UN Coalition
verification_note: North Korea invaded June 25, 1950; US led 21-nation UN coalition under MacArthur. NSC-68 confirmed concurrent.

title: Truman Orders Hydrogen Bomb Development
verification_note: Truman authorized H-bomb development January 31, 1950, following Soviet nuclear test August 29, 1949.

title: Truman Fires General MacArthur
verification_note: Truman relieved MacArthur April 11, 1951, for publicly contradicting administration Korea policy.

title: Japanese Peace Treaty and US-Japan Security Alliance
verification_note: Treaty of San Francisco signed September 8, 1951 by 49 nations; bilateral security treaty signed same day.

title: Korean War Armistice Signed
verification_note: Armistice signed July 27, 1953; DMZ near 38th parallel. US deaths ~37,000 (description says 36,000 — close enough, not materially wrong).

title: CIA Orchestrates Iranian Coup
verification_note: Operation Ajax/TP-AJAX overthrew Mosaddegh August 19, 1953; CIA and British MI6 involvement confirmed.

title: Brown v. Board of Education Ruling
verification_note: Unanimous 9-0 ruling May 17, 1954; overturned Plessy v. Ferguson (1896) separate-but-equal doctrine.

title: Senate Censures McCarthy — Red Scare Ends
verification_note: Senate voted 67-22 to censure McCarthy December 2, 1954. Vote count matches exactly.

title: Interstate Highway Act Signed
verification_note: Federal-Aid Highway Act signed June 29, 1956; authorized 41,000 miles of interstate highways.

title: Suez Crisis — US Forces Allied Withdrawal
verification_note: Eisenhower applied financial and political pressure; Britain, France, Israel withdrew. British, French forces left December 1956.

title: Eisenhower Deploys Troops to Enforce Little Rock Desegregation
verification_note: Eisenhower sent 101st Airborne September 1957; Faubus used National Guard to block nine Black students.

title: NASA Created — Space Race Launched
verification_note: NASA established by National Aeronautics and Space Act signed July 29, 1958; opened October 1, 1958.

title: U-2 Spy Plane Incident Derails Superpower Summit
verification_note: U-2 shot down May 1, 1960; Powers captured. Paris summit cancelled. All facts confirmed.

title: Bay of Pigs Invasion Fails
verification_note: CIA-trained Brigade 2506 invaded April 17, 1961; defeated within two days. Strengthened Castro.

title: Cuban Missile Crisis
verification_note: Crisis ran October 16-28, 1962 (13 days); naval blockade and secret diplomacy resolved it.

title: Kennedy Assassinated — Johnson Assumes Presidency
verification_note: Kennedy shot November 22, 1963 in Dallas; Johnson sworn in same day aboard Air Force One.

title: Limited Nuclear Test Ban Treaty Signed
verification_note: Signed August 5, 1963 by US, USSR, UK in Moscow; prohibited atmospheric, outer space, underwater tests.

title: Civil Rights Act of 1964 Signed
verification_note: Johnson signed July 2, 1964; outlawed discrimination by race, color, religion, sex, national origin.

title: Gulf of Tonkin Resolution — Vietnam War Authorization
verification_note: Congress passed August 7, 1964; House 414-0, Senate 88-2. Gave Johnson broad Vietnam authority.

title: Voting Rights Act Signed
verification_note: Signed August 6, 1965; outlawed discriminatory voting practices that disenfranchised Black voters.

title: Medicare and Medicaid Created
verification_note: Johnson signed Social Security Amendments July 30, 1965 creating both programs.

title: Tet Offensive Transforms Vietnam War
verification_note: Tet Offensive launched January 30-31, 1968; destroyed public support; Johnson announced no reelection March 31, 1968.

title: Fair Housing Act Passed
verification_note: Passed April 10-11, 1968, seven days after King's assassination April 4, 1968.

title: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
verification_note: Armstrong and Aldrin landed July 20, 1969; Armstrong first to walk on the moon.

title: US Invades Cambodia — Kent State Killings Follow
verification_note: Nixon announced Cambodia invasion April 30, 1970; National Guard killed four students at Kent State May 4, 1970.

title: Nixon Ends Dollar's Gold Convertibility — Nixon Shock
verification_note: Nixon suspended gold convertibility August 15, 1971; effectively ended Bretton Woods system.

title: Pentagon Papers Published
verification_note: NYT began publishing June 13, 1971; WaPo June 18, 1971. Supreme Court ruled 6-3 for newspapers June 30, 1971.

title: Nixon Opens Diplomatic Relations with China
verification_note: Nixon visited China February 1972; ended 23 years of no official diplomatic ties; Shanghai Communiqué issued.

title: Watergate Break-in Begins Constitutional Crisis
verification_note: Break-in at DNC Watergate headquarters June 17, 1972; led to Nixon's resignation two years later.

title: Vietnam Peace Accords Signed
verification_note: Paris Peace Accords signed January 27, 1973; ended direct US military involvement. ~58,000 US deaths total confirmed.

title: Arab Oil Embargo Triggers Energy Crisis
verification_note: OAPEC embargo imposed October 1973 in response to US support for Israel in Yom Kippur War; oil price quadrupled.

title: Nixon Resigns Presidency Over Watergate
verification_note: Nixon resigned August 9, 1974 after Supreme Court 8-0 ruling ordering tape release; first and only president to resign.

title: Fall of Saigon Ends Vietnam War
verification_note: North Vietnamese captured Saigon April 30, 1975; helicopter evacuations confirmed.

title: Carter Signs Panama Canal Treaties
verification_note: Torrijos-Carter Treaties signed September 1977; control transferred December 31, 1999 as described.

title: Camp David Accords Broker Israeli-Egyptian Peace
verification_note: Signed September 17, 1978 by Sadat and Begin after 13 days of negotiations brokered by Carter.

title: Iran Hostage Crisis Begins
verification_note: Embassy seized November 4, 1979; 52 Americans held 444 days. Description says 52, matches final hostage count.

title: Volcker Shock — Fed Raises Interest Rates Sharply
verification_note: Volcker announced new policy October 6, 1979; federal funds rate peaked at 20% in June 1981.

title: Carter Responds to Soviet Invasion of Afghanistan
verification_note: Soviet invasion December 1979; Carter imposed sanctions, boycotted 1980 Olympics, began arming mujahideen via Operation Cyclone.

title: Reagan Tax Cuts — Economic Recovery Tax Act
verification_note: Signed August 13, 1981; top marginal rate cut from 70% to 50%, largest tax cut in US history at the time.

title: Marine Barracks Bombing in Beirut
verification_note: Truck bomb October 23, 1983 killed 241 US service members. All facts confirmed.

title: Iran-Contra Affair Exposed
verification_note: Came to light November 1986; arms sold to Iran, proceeds funneled to Nicaraguan Contras in defiance of congressional ban.

title: INF Treaty Eliminates Nuclear Missiles in Europe
verification_note: Signed December 8, 1987 by Reagan and Gorbachev; eliminated entire class of intermediate-range nuclear weapons.

title: Americans with Disabilities Act Signed
verification_note: Bush signed ADA July 26, 1990; world's first comprehensive civil rights law for people with disabilities.

title: Gulf War — Operation Desert Storm Liberates Kuwait
verification_note: Ground campaign (Operation Desert Sabre) ran February 24-28, 1991 — exactly 100 hours. Kuwait liberated.

title: NAFTA Passed by Congress
verification_note: Congress approved NAFTA Implementation Act November 1993; Clinton signed December 8, 1993.

title: Dayton Accords End Bosnian War
verification_note: Agreement signed November 21, 1995; US brokered by Holbrooke. NATO deployed 60,000 peacekeepers (description says 60,000, confirmed).

title: Clinton Reelected — Welfare Reform Signed
verification_note: Welfare reform signed August 22, 1996; Clinton defeated Dole November 5, 1996.

title: Clinton Impeached by House of Representatives
verification_note: House impeached December 19, 1998 on perjury and obstruction; Senate acquitted February 1999.

title: Gramm-Leach-Bliley Repeals Glass-Steagall
verification_note: Signed November 12, 1999; repealed Glass-Steagall separation of commercial and investment banking.

title: Bush Wins Disputed Presidential Election
verification_note: Bush won Florida by 537 votes after Supreme Court halted recount; Gore won popular vote. All facts confirmed.

title: September 11 Terrorist Attacks
verification_note: 19 al-Qaeda hijackers; 2,977 killed. Description says 'nearly 3,000' — confirmed.

title: War in Afghanistan Begins
verification_note: Operation Enduring Freedom began October 7, 2001; lasted ~20 years, America's longest war.

title: USA PATRIOT Act Dramatically Expands Surveillance
verification_note: Signed October 26, 2001; dramatically expanded government surveillance powers for counterterrorism.

title: US Invades Iraq
verification_note: Invasion began March 20, 2003; Saddam overthrown in weeks; no WMDs found; years of insurgency followed.

title: Abu Ghraib Prison Abuse Scandal
verification_note: Year is wrong for the described event. The description states 'Photographs documenting US soldiers abusing Iraqi prisoners...became public' — this happened in April 2004, not 2003. The prison reopened in 2003, but the public scandal broke one year later.

title: Hurricane Katrina — Catastrophic Federal Response Failure
verification_note: Katrina hit August 2005; levees failed, ~80% of New Orleans flooded. Death toll revised to ~1,392 (description says 'over 1,800' — the earlier widely-cited figure, now revised down, but not materially false).

title: Iraq Surge Strategy Announced
verification_note: Bush announced surge January 10, 2007; 20,000 additional combat troops under Petraeus counterinsurgency strategy.

title: Financial Crisis — Lehman Collapse and TARP Bailout
verification_note: Lehman filed bankruptcy September 15, 2008; Congress authorized $700 billion TARP. Largest government financial intervention since Depression.

title: Barack Obama Elected First Black President
verification_note: Obama defeated McCain November 4, 2008; first African American elected president.

title: American Recovery and Reinvestment Act Passed
verification_note: Obama signed $787 billion stimulus February 17, 2009; largest fiscal stimulus in US history at the time.

title: Affordable Care Act Signed — Obamacare
verification_note: Signed March 23, 2010; extended coverage to millions. Most sweeping healthcare overhaul since Medicare.

title: Dodd-Frank Financial Reform Enacted
verification_note: Signed July 21, 2010; created CFPB and imposed oversight on systemically important financial institutions.

title: Osama bin Laden Killed in Pakistan
verification_note: SEAL Team Six killed bin Laden May 2, 2011 in Abbottabad compound. All facts confirmed.

title: Snowden NSA Surveillance Revelations
verification_note: Snowden leaked to Guardian and WaPo starting June 2013; revealed global surveillance scope.

title: Supreme Court Legalizes Same-Sex Marriage Nationally
verification_note: Obergefell v. Hodges decided June 26, 2015; 5-4 ruling; applies to all 50 states.

title: Iran Nuclear Deal Signed
verification_note: JCPOA reached July 14, 2015 with P5+1 plus Germany and EU; Trump withdrew 2018.

title: Trump Elected President — Political Realignment
verification_note: Trump defeated Clinton; won Electoral College (304 votes), lost popular vote by ~2.87 million. All facts confirmed.

title: Trump Withdraws from Paris Climate Agreement
verification_note: Trump announced withdrawal June 1, 2017; Biden rejoined 2021; Trump withdrew again January 2025.

title: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act Signed
verification_note: Signed December 22, 2017; corporate rate cut from 35% to 21%; estimated $1.5 trillion deficit addition.

title: Trump Withdraws from Iran Nuclear Deal
verification_note: Trump announced withdrawal May 8, 2018; sanctions fully reimposed November 5, 2018.

title: Trade War with China Escalates
verification_note: US imposed tariffs on $250 billion in Chinese goods; China retaliated. All facts confirmed.

title: Trump Impeached for First Time — Ukraine Affair
verification_note: House impeached December 18, 2019 on abuse of power and obstruction; Senate acquitted February 5, 2020.

title: COVID-19 Pandemic — CARES Act and Operation Warp Speed
verification_note: CARES Act $2.2 trillion signed March 27, 2020; Operation Warp Speed announced May 15, 2020; vaccines authorized under one year.

title: Biden Defeats Trump — Record Turnout Election
verification_note: Biden won 306 electoral votes and 81 million popular votes (record). Trump refused to concede. All facts confirmed.

title: January 6 Capitol Insurrection
verification_note: Trump supporters breached Capitol January 6, 2021; ~140 officers injured; multiple deaths. Led to second impeachment.

title: US Withdraws from Afghanistan — Taliban Returns
verification_note: US withdrawal completed August 30, 2021; Taliban seized Kabul August 15, 2021; chaotic evacuation confirmed.

title: Dobbs Decision Overturns Roe v. Wade
verification_note: Dobbs decided June 24, 2022; 6-3 ruling (5 joined full opinion overturning Roe); 49-year-old right eliminated.

title: Inflation Reduction Act — Largest US Climate Investment
verification_note: Biden signed August 16, 2022; $369 billion for climate investment, largest in US history.

title: CHIPS and Science Act Revives Semiconductor Production
verification_note: Signed August 9, 2022; $52.7 billion for chips manufacturing plus ~$174-200 billion for science. Facts confirmed.

title: Trump Indicted — First Former President Charged Federally
verification_note: Indicted June 8, 2023 on 37 counts related to classified documents. Later indicted three more times. All facts confirmed.

title: Trump Wins Presidential Election — Second Non-Consecutive Term
verification_note: Trump won 312 electoral votes and popular vote (49.8%). Second non-consecutive term president after Grover Cleveland.

title: Supreme Court Rules Trump Has Presidential Immunity
verification_note: Trump v. United States decided July 1, 2024; 6-3 ruling; substantial immunity for official acts confirmed.

title: Trump Second Term — Mass Deportation and Immigration Orders
verification_note: Sweeping executive orders signed January 20, 2025; mass deportation operations, birthright citizenship attempt; legal challenges confirmed.

title: US Imposes Sweeping Global Tariffs
verification_note: Liberation Day April 2, 2025; 10% baseline tariff on all imports; effective tariff rate exceeded Smoot-Hawley levels.

title: DOGE Created — Unprecedented Federal Workforce Reduction
verification_note: DOGE established by executive order January 20, 2025; Musk led it; ~9% federal workforce reduction (~270,000 workers) confirmed.
